title: Drawgent: Coding agent on a live Excalidraw canvas
summary: Drawgent is a coding agent that operates on a live Excalidraw canvas, allowing users to interact with an AI coding assistant through a visual whiteboard interface. It combines the collaborative drawing capabilities of Excalidraw with AI-powered code generation and execution.
problem_solved: Provides a visual, interactive approach to AI-assisted coding by integrating directly with Excalidraw's collaborative whiteboard canvas.
why_valuable: It transforms the coding experience from text-based to visual and interactive, making AI pair programming more intuitive and collaborative.
